name: Vorinclex
description: Vorinclex, the Voice of Hunger, is the green-aligned Phyrexian praetor of New Phyrexia, a predator who rules the Vicious Swarm.

description_citations.text: "Getting to Know the Praetors". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Each color alignment gains a Praetor, factionalizing the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: each alignment gained a Praetor to oversee that color

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Factionalizing and the Castes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Praetor Vorinclex compleates the corrupted Glissa and unleashes her as a Phyrexian ally for the siege.
timeline.quote: The Praetor Vorinclex compleated the former elf hero

citation.work: Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered
citation.text: "Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The elves accuse Glissa of the damage done, calling her Glissa the Traitor; she is eventually corrupted and compleated by Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: Compleated by Vorinclex , she became the champion of the praetor

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Mirrodin Besieged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias rewrites the Scriptures' Grand Evolution as the Great Synthesis, out of distaste for Vorinclex and Glissa's talk of evolution.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias has modified the Phyrexian Scriptures in their mentioning of "The Grand Evolution."

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Glissa builds a powerful faction by exploiting discontent, surviving assassination attempts with Vorinclex's help.
timeline.quote: surviving several assassination attempts with the help of Vorinclex—she constructed a powerful faction through cunning and strength.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Vorinclex pioneer accelerated growth and she creates crotus blooms in her gardens.
timeline.quote: She and Vorinclex pioneered a method of escalated growth using an amalgamation of tendon, fat, and brain matter.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Glissa warps crotus blooms into crotus beasts as her enforcers, and Phyrexian leadership, unaware of her plans, puts Vorinclex over the forest and assigns Glissa the compleation of local Mirrans.
timeline.quote: Over time, she warped the crotus blooms into crotus beasts, which become her enforcers.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Urabrask deploys predators and constructs in the Oxidda Mountains as intrusion countermeasures.
timeline.quote: they serve as intrusion countermeasures.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Glissa pressed Phyrexians to leave the Core and assault the surface of Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Glissa pressed for Phyrexians to leave the Core and begin the assault on the surface of Mirrodin

citation.text: "Getting to Know the Praetors". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex's forces are partly consumed as fuel for the rest.
timeline.quote: A substantial portion of Vorinclex's forces became fuel for the rest.

citation.text: Leeching Bite (New Phyrexia, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: In the World Tree's sanctum, a monster has mortally wounded the goddess Esika.
timeline.quote: Esika was dying.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The monster tells Esika she lacks the hunger and fear to survive and drops her.
timeline.quote: Not enough hunger in you. Not enough fear to survive. Soon, though.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The monster takes a sample of the World Tree's sap and prepares to return.
timeline.quote: I am ready to return.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: A red portal opens and a voice welcomes Vorinclex back.
timeline.quote: We step ever closer to perfection.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex mortally wounds Esika in the Tyrite Sanctum, draws sap from the World Tree and opens a planar portal.
timeline.quote: Esika , goddess of the World Tree , was mortally wounded by Vorinclex

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Inga's party engage Vorinclex in Aldergard and Alrund reveals himself.
timeline.quote: the party engaged Vorinclex

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bridge sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim to obtain Tyrite and brings him back to New Phyrexia, burning off his organic parts each way.
timeline.quote: The Planar Bridge was used to transport the praetor Vorinclex to the plane of Kaldheim to obtain a sample of Tyrite

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex ambushes Tibalt, infects him with phyresis and holds him hostage.
timeline.quote: Tibalt was ambushed by Vorinclex , who infected him with phyresis

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex is sent to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge on Norn's orders; the process destroys his body and he rebuilds himself.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex was sent to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge on Norn's orders.

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex infects Tibalt, forcing him to cause a distraction in exchange for an antidote.
timeline.quote: he ambushed the planeswalker Tibalt and infected him

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya and the Omenseekers fight Vorinclex; Alrund reveals himself and the praetor flees.
timeline.quote: The god Alrund revealed himself, too disgusted at Vorinclex, and the praetor fled

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex mauls Esika to near death, takes a tyrite sample and returns to New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex invaded the sanctum of Esika and mauled her to near death.

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer reveals Vorinclex is nearby and recovered from his journey to Kaldheim, and Lukka and Nissa decide to attack him.
timeline.quote: We need to take him down before he hurts anyone else.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: At the center of the maze they find Vorinclex sparring joyfully with Glissa.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex fought a Phyrexian elf beneath the monstrous skulls that hung from the ceiling.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka charges in against Glissa while Nissa fights Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: Without another word, Lukka charged in.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Glissa takes command of Lukka, ordering him to find but not kill Nissa, and Lukka sets out hunting.
timeline.quote: Find the elf, Lukka. But do not kill her.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn overwhelms Sheoldred's and Urabrask's forces and becomes the dominant praetor, the Mother of Machines.
timeline.quote: She then became the Mother of Machines, the highest power in New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Victorious". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth duels Norn to a stalemate, stabbing her through the shoulder, and flies off to cover the attack on Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: was subsequently stabbed through the shoulder by Elspeth.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfiran army turns the tide, Vorinclex is killed, and Wrenn shifts Zhalfir into New Phyrexia's place in the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: The Green Praetor Vorinclex was soon killed in the melee

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa becomes Vorinclex's steward and commander of much of the Vicious Swarm, helping design the Hunter Maze.
timeline.quote: leaving Glissa as his steward to handle long-term matters and other factions.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Phyrexia: All Will be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka is compleated, fully merging with his companion, and Glissa orders him to capture Nissa alive.
timeline.quote: By the time he fought Glissa and Vorinclex , he fully bonded with his companion and the two became one.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex retrieves a tyrite sample from Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: they sent Vorinclex , who successfully fulfilled his mission and retrieved a sample

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex infects Tibalt with a seed.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex also infected Tibalt with a "seed", wounded the god Esika

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After conquering Mirrodin, Elesh Norn starts a civil war against the other praetors and emerges as sole power above New Phyrexia, evolving the Machine Orthodoxy into the Machine Legion.
timeline.quote: Emerging as the Mother of Machines and sole power above all of New Phyrexia

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex invades Kaldheim and is confronted by Kaya, Alrund and the Omenseekers; he wounds Esika and leaves with a tyrite sample.
timeline.quote: he fought and wounded the god Esika before leaving Kaldheim with a sample of tyrite

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Vorinclex on Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Hunter Maze Lukka fuses with Rothga and is fully compleated after fighting Vorinclex and Glissa.
timeline.quote: Lukka fusing with Rothga, fully compleating him

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka compleats himself and Nissa flees from him after dueling Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: Lukka had compleated himself and Nissa fled, hunted by the other planeswalker.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim for a sample of tyrite.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn sent Vorinclex to the plane of Keldheim to retrieve a sample of tyrite

citation.text: "Plane", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker was grown in the Seedcore of New Phyrexia from tyrite taken from the World Tree.
timeline.quote: Realmbreaker was grown in the Seedcore , the innermost sphere of New Phyrexia

citation.text: "Realmbreaker", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka and Nissa attack Vorinclex and Glissa in the Hunter Maze; Nissa wounds Vorinclex and a compleated Lukka puts her on the run.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex was severely wounded by Nissa, but a compleated Lukka put Nissa on the run

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Phyrexia: All Will be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn, lashed to slag held aloft by Norn's choir, is being taken apart as Norn taunts him.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have been taking him apart, piece by piece, and repurposing his silver body.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex tears Teferi's mount apart and attacks him, but an Askari named Shella beheads the praetor.
timeline.quote: A blazing sword severs Vorinclex's head from his body.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex's Copper Host invades, terraforming the desert and trying to convert the dead; survivors go into hiding then strike back.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex's Copper Host was the main invasion force on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex's invasion force devastates human culture while Ikoria's monsters turn on the invaders.
timeline.quote: Ikoria's monsters focused their ire upon the invaders rather than the local populace.

citation.text: "Ikoria", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex and Elesh Norn are slain.
timeline.quote: In the battle that followed, Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex, and Elesh Norn were slain.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex and Elesh Norn are slain, leaving Urabrask the only living praetor.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex, and Elesh Norn were slain, leaving Urabrask as the only living praetor

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn breaks off one of Vorinclex's horns to throw at Elspeth Tirel.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn in despair broke off one of Vorinclex's horns to throw it at the archangel planeswalker.

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex meets the invaders head-on when Zhalfir is switched with New Phyrexia and may be killed.
timeline.quote: his ultimate fate remains to be seen.

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Possible death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As Asi, Alrund joins Inga Rune-Eyes and Kaya to hunt a dangerous monster that proves to be Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: This turned out to be none other than Vorinclex

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Aldergard the party fights Vorinclex; Alrund reveals himself and creates a barrier, and the praetor leaves Bretagard.
timeline.quote: the praetor left Bretagard, with Kaya soon following

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn, with Jin-Gitaxias, Sheoldred and Vorinclex, compleats Atraxa while Urabrask declines.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias , Sheoldred , and Vorinclex all agreed to join Elesh Norn's efforts, and Atraxa was born

citation.text: "Atraxa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya is given use of Cosima's longboat to find Vorinclex but is steered to Gnottvold to find Tibalt.
timeline.quote: but was steered towards Gnottvold to find Tibalt instead.

citation.text: "Cosima", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians win and remake the plane as New Phyrexia, nine spheres each ruled by a praetor faction.
timeline.quote: The plane was fully seized and transformed into New Phyrexia

citation.text: "Creation of New Phyrexia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex finds Esika's sanctum and mauls her; dying, she revives herself with the Cosmos Elixir.
timeline.quote: On the brink of death, she revived herself using the Cosmos Elixir.

citation.text: "Esika", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Inga joins the planeswalker Kaya to hunt a dangerous monster, which proves to be Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: Inga joined up with the planeswalker Kaya to hunt an extremely dangerous monster that already had caused destruction on the plane.

citation.text: "Inga Rune-Eyes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Aldergard forest the party fights Vorinclex; Asi reveals himself as Alrund, who raises a barrier, and Vorinclex leaves Bretagard.
timeline.quote: Alrund used his magic to create a mystical barrier between Vorinclex and Inga's people and the praetor left Bretagard

citation.text: "Inga Rune-Eyes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex steals a fragment of the World Tree's essence, which becomes the Phyrexian Invasion Tree and disrupts Esika's navigation of the Cosmos.
timeline.quote: Esika lost her ability to navigate the vast, interplanar pathways that make up the Cosmos

citation.text: "Inga Rune-Eyes", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim for tyrite used to create Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn sent Vorinclex to Kaldheim to retrieve tyrite

citation.text: "Planar portal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex takes a sample of tyrite.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex took a sample of tyrite during his exploits on Kaldheim

citation.text: "World Tree", section "Tyrite". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
